comments.content: Off-by-one: the loop starts at `i := 1`, so the first invoice line is never added to the total; a single-line invoice totals 0. The story requires the sum of every line. Use `for _, l := range lines { sum += l.Cents * int64(l.Qty) }`.

ParseQty ignores the strconv.Atoi error and never checks the minimum, so it always returns a nil error: non-numeric input ("abc", "1.5", "") becomes 0, and 0 or negative quantities are accepted. Negative quantities from the form flow into Total and reduce/negate the invoice. Return the Atoi error and reject n < 1, as the contract requires.
